title: Prompt Shields route policy (route-policy.v1)
description: One routing policy shared by the gateway router (TypeScript), the SDK local router and the teardown replay (Python). Precedence: data policy constraints > explicit group (X-PS-Route) > hints (quality, max_cost) > use-case quality bar > default strategy. Cross-field rules JSON Schema cannot express: default_group, quality_to_group values, group_order entries and use_cases.*.min_group must name keys of groups; sensitivity.unclassified_default, pii_escalation values and data_policy keys must be entries of sensitivity.levels.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editors.

policy_version.description: Free-form version of this policy document. Recorded as policy_version on every routed event.

default_group.description: Group used when no hint applies, and the fallback target for an unknown or empty group.

group_order.description: Groups from least to most capable. Needed to compare against a use case's min_group.

groups.description: Group name -> candidate models. Order inside a group does not matter; the router ranks by estimated cost.

quality_to_group.description: Maps the SDK quality intent (X-PS-Quality) to a group.

strategy.description: Strategy used on the transparent path (no explicit group, no quality hint).

data_policy.description: Sensitivity level -> constraints a candidate must meet. Applied before any strategy. No compliant candidate means the call fails closed with PolicyViolation.

use_cases.description: Per-use-case quality bar, keyed by the use_case the caller declares.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, a bloc such as EEA, or 'any'.

zdr.description: Provider offers zero data retention for this model.

levels.description: Sensitivity levels from least to most sensitive.

unclassified_default.description: Level used when the caller declares none or classification fails. Never 'lowest level' by accident.

pii_escalation.description: Detected PII category -> minimum level. Escalate-only: effective level = max(declared or default, every escalated level).

providers.description: Allow-list of providers. Omitted means any provider in an allowed jurisdiction.

us_cloud_act_exposure.description: false excludes candidates exposed to the US CLOUD Act. Omitted means no constraint.

min_group.description: Lowest group (per group_order) this use case may be routed to.

eval_set.description: Eval set id. When set, only models in eligible_models may serve this use case.

eligible_models.description: Models that passed eval_set at min_parity. Written back by the eval harness.

unknown_group.description: Unknown or empty group (explicit or mapped): route within default_group.

budget_unsatisfiable.description: No candidate fits max_cost: serve the cheapest candidate and flag it, or fail.

no_compliant_candidate.description: Never downgraded to a non-compliant model.

max_attempts.description: Upper bound on provider attempts per call, all within the same constraint set.

retry_after_max_wait_ms.description: Longest Retry-After honored on 429 before moving to the next candidate.

content_filter_refusal.description: A provider content-filter refusal is never retried on a laxer model.
